integration-by-parts-areas.alt: In the u-v plane, the curve v = ln u runs from (1, 0) to (e, 1). The region under it, from u = 1 to u = e, is shaded green with area 1 (the integral of v du). The region to its left, from v = 0 to v = 1, is shaded blue with area e − 1, about 1.718 (the integral of u dv). Together they fill the dashed rectangle of area uv = e, so the integral of v du is uv minus the integral of u dv.
